Space between rows (flex lines / grid rows).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;th&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px"><tr><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 10px">Name</th><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 10px">Score</th></tr><tr><th style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 10px;background:#fafafa">Ali</th><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 10px">92</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2" style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 10px;background:#eff6ff;font-weight:600">Top scorer: Ali</td></tr></table></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;th scope=&quot;col&quot;&gt;Name&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th scope=&quot;col&quot;&gt;Score&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;th scope=&quot;row&quot;&gt;Ali&lt;/th&gt;&lt;td&gt;92&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;th colspan=&quot;2&quot;&gt;Top scorer: Ali&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>row-gap</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>th { row-gap: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is being pressed/clicked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>B. <code>:target</code></li><li>C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:active</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7641">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7642 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7643">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7643" data-page="7643" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6766"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7643 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6766 — strike × place-items</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">strike</span> <span class="badge prop">place-items</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-items</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;strike&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: strike (obsolete). Shorthand: align-items + justify-items (align every cell&#x27;s content).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;strike&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="text-decoration:line-through;font-size:13px">Struck text — use <s> or CSS</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;strike&gt;Struck text&lt;/strike&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>place-items</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>strike { place-items: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The sole child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7642">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7643 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7644">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7644" data-page="7644" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6767"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7644 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6767 — basefont × font-feature-settings</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">basefont</span> <span class="badge prop">font-feature-settings</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-feature-settings</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;basefont&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: base font (obsolete). Thickness of the decoration line.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;del&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px"><del style="color:#9ca3af">Old price: $99</del> → <b>$79</b> <small>(deleted 2026-09-10)</small></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;del datetime=&quot;2026-09-10&quot;&gt;Old price: $99&lt;/del&gt; → $79</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-decoration-thickness</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>del { text-decoration-thickness: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Everything EXCEPT the selector inside.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>.class</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7644">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7645 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7646">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7646" data-page="7646" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6769"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7646 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6769 — meta × direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">meta</span> <span class="badge prop">direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;meta&gt;</code> — machine-readable metadata about the document (encoding, viewport, description, authors). Delay before the first cycle starts.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;i&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">The word <i>rendezvous</i> is borrowed from French.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;The word &lt;i&gt;rendezvous&lt;/i&gt; is borrowed from French.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>i { animation-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Generated content INSIDE the end of the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>.class</code></li><li>B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::after</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7650">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7651 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7652">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7652" data-page="7652" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6775"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7652 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6775 — q × scale</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">q</span> <span class="badge prop">scale</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scale</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;q&gt;</code> — a short inline quotation (rendered with quotation marks). Independent scale (composes with transform).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;q&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">As the docs say, <q>HTML is the skeleton</q>.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;As the docs say, &lt;q cite=&quot;https://w3.org/&quot;&gt;HTML is the skeleton&lt;/q&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scale</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>q { scale: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The user&#x27;s text selection.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr=value]</code></li><li>B. <code>:active</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::selection</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7651">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7652 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7653">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7653" data-page="7653" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6776"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7653 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6776 — code × aspect-ratio</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">code</span> <span class="badge prop">aspect-ratio</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">aspect-ratio</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;code&gt;</code> — a fragment of computer code. Locks the width:height ratio (16/9, 1/1, 4/3…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;code&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Use <code style="font-family:monospace;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">display: grid</code> for layouts.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Use &lt;code&gt;display: grid&lt;/code&gt; for layouts.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>aspect-ratio</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>code { aspect-ratio: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The dim layer behind an open &lt;dialog&gt;.showModal().”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li><li>B. <code>:only-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::backdrop</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7652">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7653 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7654">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7654" data-page="7654" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6777"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7654 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6777 — bdi × padding-inline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdi</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-inline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-inline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdi&gt;</code> — isolates text so its direction does not affect surrounding text. Logical left+right padding (flips with direction).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdi&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Hello <bdi dir="auto" style="background:#fef9c3;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">مرحبا</bdi> world — isolated, layout-safe</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Hello &lt;bdi dir=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;مرحبا&lt;/bdi&gt; world&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-inline</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdi { padding-inline: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of display?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>block</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>inline</code></li><li>C. <code>banana</code></li><li>D. <code>solid2</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7653">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7654 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7655">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7655" data-page="7655" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6778"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7655 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6778 — dd × box-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dd</span> <span class="badge prop">box-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">box-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dd&gt;</code> — the description (details) for a term in a description list. One or more shadows around the box.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dd&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;color:#4b5563;margin-left:18px">World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet. <i>(dd)</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;Web&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet.&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>box-shadow</b> = <b>multiple</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dd { box-shadow: multiple; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of height?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>100dvh</code></li><li>B. <code>never</code></li><li>C. <code>always</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>auto</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7654">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7655 / 8000 · Practice 34</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7656">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7656" data-page="7656" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6779"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 34</span><span>Page 7656 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6779 — canvas × overflow-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">canvas</span> <span class="badge prop">overflow-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">overflow-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;canvas&gt;</code> — a bitmap drawing surface controlled by the 2d api or webgl. Break long words so they don&#x27;t overflow (break-word).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;canvas&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><canvas width="200" height="80" style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:6px;background:#fff"></canvas><script>document.querySelector("canvas").getContext("2d").fillStyle="#4285f4",document.querySelector("canvas").getContext("2d").fillRect(10,10,80,40)</script></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;canvas id=&quot;c&quot; width=&quot;200&quot; height=&quot;80&quot;&gt;&lt;/canvas&gt; &lt;script&gt; const x = document.querySelector(&quot;#c&quot;).getContext(&quot;2d&quot;); x.fillStyle = &quot;#4285f4&quot;; x.fillRect(10, 10, 80, 40); x.fillStyle = &quot;#34a853&quot;; x.fillRect(100, 20, 80, 40); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-wrap</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>canvas { overflow-wrap: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Highlights text for utilitarian reasons without extra importance.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;dir&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;b&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7698">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7699 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7700">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7700" data-page="7700" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6823"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7700 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6823 — title × margin-left</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">title</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-left</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-left</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;title&gt;</code> — defines the document title, shown in the browser tab and search results. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;tfoot&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;figcaption&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;li&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7707">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7708 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7709">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7709" data-page="7709" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6832"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7709 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6832 — li × background-attachment</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">background-attachment</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-attachment</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; Whether flex items wrap to multiple lines.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;bdi&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Hello <bdi dir="auto" style="background:#fef9c3;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px">مرحبا</bdi> world — isolated, layout-safe</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Hello &lt;bdi dir=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;مرحبا&lt;/bdi&gt; world&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-wrap</b> = <b>nowrap</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>bdi { flex-wrap: nowrap; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “The mouse cursor over the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>perspective-origin</code></li><li>B. <code>perspective</code></li><li>C. <code>text-decoration-thickness</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>cursor</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7780">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7781 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7782">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7782" data-page="7782" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6905"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7782 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6905 — dd × order</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dd</span> <span class="badge prop">order</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">order</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dd&gt;</code> — the description (details) for a term in a description list. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “The point transforms rotate/scale around.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>outline</code></li><li>B. <code>font-weight</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>transform-origin</code></li><li>D. <code>isolation</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7792">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7793 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7794">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7794" data-page="7794" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6917"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7794 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6917 — h4 × border</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h4</span> <span class="badge prop">border</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h4&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 4 (h1 = highest). Prevents floats on one or both sides (moves the box below them).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;pre&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><pre style="background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;font-size:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:6px;margin:0">function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }</pre></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code&gt;function sum(a, b) { return a + b; }&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>clear</b> = <b>both</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>pre { clear: both; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Move the element along an SVG path (motion path).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>offset-path</code></li><li>B. <code>top</code></li><li>C. <code>font-kerning</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7794">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7795 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7796">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7796" data-page="7796" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6919"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7796 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6919 — strong × content-visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">strong</span> <span class="badge prop">content-visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">content-visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;strong&gt;</code> — marks text of strong importance, seriousness or urgency. Skip rendering of off-screen subtrees (auto + contain-intrinsic-size).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;strong&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><strong>Warning:</strong> This action cannot be undone.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Warning:&lt;/strong&gt; This action cannot be undone.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content-visibility</b> = <b>visible</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>strong { content-visibility: visible; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches every element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:focus</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7795">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7796 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7797">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7797" data-page="7797" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6920"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7797 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6920 — cite × flex-grow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">cite</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-grow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-grow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;cite&gt;</code> — the title of a creative work (book, film, song, page). Spans grid columns (shorthand: col-start / col-end).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;samp&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">If you see <samp style="font-family:monospace;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">404 Not Found</samp>, the page is missing.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;If you see &lt;samp&gt;404 Not Found&lt;/samp&gt;, the page is missing.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-column</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>samp { grid-column: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value starts with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>B. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7797">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7798 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7799">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7799" data-page="7799" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6922"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7799 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6922 — rp × font-weight</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">rp</span> <span class="badge prop">font-weight</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-weight</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;rp&gt;</code> — fallback parentheses for ruby annotations in browsers without ruby support. The thickness of the text (100–900 or keywords).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;rp&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;font-family:serif;color:#6b7280">木(mù) — what old browsers would see</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;木&lt;rp&gt;(&lt;/rp&gt;&lt;rt&gt;mù&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;rp&gt;)&lt;/rp&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-weight</b> = <b>100–900</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>rp { font-weight: 100–900; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches an element in a state.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>B. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:</code></li><li>D. <code>~</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7798">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7799 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7800">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7800" data-page="7800" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6923"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7800 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6923 — dt × text-align-last</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dt</span> <span class="badge prop">text-align-last</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-align-last</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dt&gt;</code> — the term (name) in a description list. Alignment of the last line (matters with justify).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dt&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700">term <span style="font-weight:400;color:#6b7280">(dt)</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;term&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;definition&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-align-last</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dt { text-align-last: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Focus via keyboard (not mouse click).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>B. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>D. <code>::first-letter</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7799">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7800 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7801">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7801" data-page="7801" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6924"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7801 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6924 — track × hyphens</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">track</span> <span class="badge prop">hyphens</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">hyphens</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;track&gt;</code> — captions, subtitles or chapters for &lt;video&gt;/&lt;audio&gt;. Automatic hyphenation of long words.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;track&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#000;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;text-align:center">“Welcome to the course”</div><div style="text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">CC · English (default) · Chapters</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;movie.mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;English&quot; default&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>hyphens</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>track { hyphens: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:checked</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>D. <code>::placeholder</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7800">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7801 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7802">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7802" data-page="7802" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6925"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7802 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6925 — param × background-position</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">param</span> <span class="badge prop">background-position</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-position</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;param&gt;</code> — a named parameter passed to an &lt;object&gt; resource. Where the background image sits.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;param&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">name="quality" value="high" → passed to the object</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;object data=&quot;game.swf&quot; type=&quot;application/x-shockwave-flash&quot;&gt; &lt;param name=&quot;quality&quot; value=&quot;high&quot;&gt; &lt;/object&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-position</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>param { background-position: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child OF ITS TAG type (ignores other tags).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7801">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7802 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7803">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7803" data-page="7803" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6926"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7803 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6926 — option × backdrop-filter</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">option</span> <span class="badge prop">backdrop-filter</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">backdrop-filter</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;option&gt;</code> — a single choice inside &lt;select&gt; or &lt;datalist&gt;. Filters what is BEHIND the element (glassmorphism!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;option&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px"><div style="padding:4px 8px;background:#eff6ff;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0">✔ Alpha</div><div style="padding:4px 8px;color:#9ca3af">Beta (soon) — disabled</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;select&gt; &lt;option value=&quot;a&quot; selected&gt;Alpha&lt;/option&gt; &lt;option value=&quot;b&quot; disabled&gt;Beta (soon)&lt;/option&gt; &lt;/select&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>backdrop-filter</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>option { backdrop-filter: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “No children at all (not even text).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::after</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:empty</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7802">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7803 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7804">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7804" data-page="7804" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6927"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7804 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6927 — output × counter-increment</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">output</span> <span class="badge prop">counter-increment</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">counter-increment</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;output&gt;</code> — the result of a form calculation or user action. “Like :is but with ZERO specificity.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7803">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7804 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7805">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7805" data-page="7805" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6928"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7805 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6928 — tfoot × scroll-snap-align</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tfoot</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-snap-align</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-snap-align</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tfoot&gt;</code> — groups the footer (summary) rows of a table. “Form control usable or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>~</code></li><li>C. <code>::backdrop</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7804">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7805 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7806">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7806" data-page="7806" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6929"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7806 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6929 — big × transition-delay</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">big</span> <span class="badge prop">transition-delay</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition-delay</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;big&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: big (obsolete). Space inside the border (all four sides).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;base&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">base URL = https://docs.example.com/ → &lt;img src="a.png"&gt; loads docs.example.com/a.png</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;base href=&quot;https://docs.example.com/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding</b> = <b>12px</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>base { padding: 12px; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Generated content INSIDE the start of the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>element</code></li><li>B. <code>:</code></li><li>C. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7808">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7809 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7810">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7810" data-page="7810" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6933"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7810 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6933 — body × border-radius</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">body</span> <span class="badge prop">border-radius</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-radius</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;body&gt;</code> — contains all the visible content of the html document. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Introductory content or a set of navigational links for a section or page.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;samp&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;col&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;header&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h5&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7849">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7850 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7851">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7851" data-page="7851" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6974"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7851 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6974 — s × user-select</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">user-select</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">user-select</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). Whether the text can be selected by the user.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;s&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Price: <s style="color:#9ca3af">$99</s> <b>$79</b></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Price: &lt;s&gt;$99&lt;/s&gt; $79&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>user-select</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>s { user-select: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Contact information for the author/owner of an article or page.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;address&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;sub&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tfoot&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;hr&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7850">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7851 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7852">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7852" data-page="7852" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6975"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7852 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6975 — dfn × field-sizing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dfn</span> <span class="badge prop">field-sizing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">field-sizing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dfn&gt;</code> — the term being defined on the page. Let an input/textarea size itself to its content (content-based width).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dfn&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><dfn style="font-style:italic"><b>semantics</b></dfn>: the meaning carried by markup, not just its appearance.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;dfn&gt;semantics&lt;/dfn&gt;: the meaning of markup.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>field-sizing</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dfn { field-sizing: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 1 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;rt&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;h1&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;td&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;pre&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7851">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7852 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7853">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7853" data-page="7853" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6976"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7853 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6976 — sup × animation-delay</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sup</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-delay</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-delay</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sup&gt;</code> — superscript text (rendered above the baseline). Delay before the first cycle starts.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;sup&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">E = mc<sup>2</sup></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;E = mc&lt;sup&gt;2&lt;/sup&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>sup { animation-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 4 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;bdo&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;marquee&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;summary&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;h4&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7852">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7853 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7854">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7854" data-page="7854" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6977"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7854 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6977 — ol × scale</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ol</span> <span class="badge prop">scale</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scale</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ol&gt;</code> — a numbered list of items. Independent scale (composes with transform).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ol&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol start="2" style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Second step</li><li>Third step</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol start=&quot;2&quot;&gt; &lt;li&gt;Second step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Third step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scale</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ol { scale: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A block of text — the basic unit of written content.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;p&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;li&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;strike&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;b&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7853">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7854 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7855">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7855" data-page="7855" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6978"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7855 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6978 — source × aspect-ratio</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">source</span> <span class="badge prop">aspect-ratio</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">aspect-ratio</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;source&gt;</code> — a candidate resource for &lt;video&gt;, &lt;audio&gt; or &lt;picture&gt;. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “An optional line-break position inside long words/URLs.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;wbr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;dd&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;frame&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;em&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7854">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7855 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7856">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7856" data-page="7856" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6979"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7856 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6979 — iframe × padding-inline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">iframe</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-inline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-inline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;iframe&gt;</code> — embeds another html page in a nested browsing context. Logical left+right padding (flips with direction).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;iframe&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #8b949e;border-radius:6px;width:250px;padding:8px;background:#fff"><h1 style="font-size:14px;margin:2px 0 0">Hello from an iframe</h1><div style="font-size:10px;color:#8b949e">separate document, own DOM</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;iframe srcdoc=&quot;&lt;h1&gt;Hello from an iframe&lt;/h1&gt;&quot; width=&quot;260&quot; height=&quot;70&quot; sandbox=&quot;allow-same-origin&quot;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-inline</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>iframe { padding-inline: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A native disclosure (collapse/expand) widget — no JavaScript needed.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;source&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;applet&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;details&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;small&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7855">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7856 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7857">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7857" data-page="7857" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6980"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7857 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6980 — input × box-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">box-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">box-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. &lt;label&gt;Full name &lt;input type=&quot;text&quot; name=&quot;name&quot; required autocomplete=&quot;name&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Email &lt;input type=&quot;email&quot; name=&quot;email&quot; required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; name=&quot;news&quot; checked&gt; Newsletter&lt;/label&gt; &lt;button&gt;Send&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>box-shadow</b> = <b>multiple</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>input { box-shadow: multiple; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A neutral inline container with no meaning.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;span&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;track&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;nextid&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;q&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7856">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7857 / 8000 · Practice 35</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7858">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7858" data-page="7858" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6981"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 35</span><span>Page 7858 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6981 — label × overflow-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">label</span> <span class="badge prop">overflow-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">overflow-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;label&gt;</code> — a caption for a form control — clickable, and read by screen readers. Break long words so they don&#x27;t overflow (break-word).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;label&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;max-width:230px"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><span style="font-weight:600">Email address</span><input style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px"><input type="checkbox" checked> <span>Accept terms (wrapped label — click the text to toggle)</span></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;label for=&quot;email&quot;&gt;Email address&lt;/label&gt; &lt;input id=&quot;email&quot; type=&quot;email&quot;&gt; &lt;label&gt;Accept terms &lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; id=&quot;t&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-wrap</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>label { overflow-wrap: normal; style=&quot;background:#eef2ff&quot;&gt;&lt;/colgroup&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>align-content</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>col { align-content: …; for=&quot;a b&quot;&gt;12&lt;/output&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-play-state</b> = <b>paused</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>output { animation-play-state: paused; behaves like &lt;ul&gt;.
