}</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Where the vanishing point sits (x y).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>position</code></li><li>B. <code>font-feature-settings</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>perspective-origin</code></li><li>D. <code>shape-margin</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7952">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7953 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7954">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7954" data-page="7954" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7077"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7954 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7077 — title × justify-items</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">title</span> <span class="badge prop">justify-items</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">justify-items</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;title&gt;</code> — defines the document title, shown in the browser tab and search results. Aligns grid items on the main (inline) axis inside their cells.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;title&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#202124;color:#fff;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center"><span style="width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#4285f4"></span><b style="font-size:13px">Learn HTML — 8000 Page Bible</b> <span style="margin-left:auto">✕</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;title&gt;Learn HTML — 8000 Page Bible&lt;/title&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>justify-items</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>title { justify-items: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Rotation of the element relative to the path (auto follows the tangent).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>left</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>offset-rotate</code></li><li>C. <code>font-variation-settings</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style-position</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7953">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7954 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7955">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7955" data-page="7955" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7078"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7955 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7078 — template × font-variation-settings</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">template</span> <span class="badge prop">font-variation-settings</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-variation-settings</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;template&gt;</code> — an inert container of markup that can be cloned by javascript. Direct access to variable-font axes (wght, wdth, ital, GRAD…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;template&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#f6f8fa;border:2px dashed #8b949e;padding:10px;color:#57609a">&lt;template&gt; content is <b>inert</b> — rendered only when JS clones it into the DOM</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;template id=&quot;card&quot;&gt; &lt;div class=&quot;card&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt; &lt;/template&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-variation-settings</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>template { font-variation-settings: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by class attribute (the workhorse).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>.class</code></li><li>B. <code>:active</code></li><li>C. <code>:empty</code></li><li>D. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7954">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7955 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7956">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7956" data-page="7956" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7079"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7956 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7079 — header × text-overflow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">header</span> <span class="badge prop">text-overflow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-overflow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;header&gt;</code> — introductory content or a set of navigational links for a section or page. What to show when text overflows a clipped box (ellipsis!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;header&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4285f4,#34a853);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#fff"><b style="font-size:15px">My Blog</b><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.85;margin-top:2px">header — intro content for the page</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;header&gt; &lt;h1&gt;My Blog&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;nav&gt;...&lt;/nav&gt; &lt;/header&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-overflow</b> = <b>clip</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>header { text-overflow: clip; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches when the attribute equals a value (exact, case-sensitive).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:only-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr=value]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7955">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7956 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7957">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7957" data-page="7957" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7080"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7957 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7080 — h2 × unicode-bidi</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h2</span> <span class="badge prop">unicode-bidi</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">unicode-bidi</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h2&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 2 (h1 = highest). Control bidirectional text embedding (isolate/plane).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h2&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:21.0px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 2</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h2&gt;Heading level 2&lt;/h2&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>unicode-bidi</b> = <b>plaintext</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h2 { unicode-bidi: plaintext; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value contains the substring.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li><li>C. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>D. <code>+</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7956">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7957 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7958">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7958" data-page="7958" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7081"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7958 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7081 — br × accent-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">br</span> <span class="badge prop">accent-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">accent-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;br&gt;</code> — a single line break (forced newline) in the text. The accent color of form controls (checkboxes, radios, ranges, progress).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;br&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;background:#fafbfc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:8px;border-radius:6px">12 Main St.<br>Cairo, Egypt<br>12611</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;address&gt;12 Main St.&lt;br&gt;Cairo, Egypt&lt;br&gt;12611&lt;/address&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>accent-color</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>br { accent-color: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element has keyboard/click focus.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:focus</code></li><li>C. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>D. <code>::after</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7957">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7958 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7959">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7959" data-page="7959" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7082"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7959 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7082 — span × list-style</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">span</span> <span class="badge prop">list-style</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">list-style</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;span&gt;</code> — a neutral inline container with no meaning. Shorthand: list-style-type + position + image.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;span&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Total: <span style="color:#16a34a;font-weight:700">$49</span> <span style="color:#9ca3af;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11px">$60</span></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Total: &lt;span class=&quot;price&quot;&gt;$49&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>list-style</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>span { list-style: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “First child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>B. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>D. <code>::selection</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7958">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7959 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7960">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7960" data-page="7960" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7083"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7960 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7083 — small × touch-action</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">small</span> <span class="badge prop">touch-action</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">touch-action</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;small&gt;</code> — side comments and small print: fine print, copyrights, legal notes. What gestures the browser handles (scroll/zoom) vs the app.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;small&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Offer ends Friday. <small style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280">T&amp;Cs apply.</small></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Offer ends Friday. &lt;small&gt;T&amp;Cs apply.&lt;/small&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>touch-action</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>small { touch-action: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child (An+B formulas).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>D. <code>::backdrop</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7959">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7960 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7961">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7961" data-page="7961" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7084"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7961 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7084 — time × will-change</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">time</span> <span class="badge prop">will-change</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">will-change</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;time&gt;</code> — a machine-readable date, time, or duration (calendar integration). Hint: the element will change this property soon (promote it to a layer).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;time&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Published <time datetime="2026-09-16" style="color:#1a56db;font-weight:600">16 September 2026</time></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;time datetime=&quot;2026-09-16&quot;&gt;16 September 2026&lt;/time&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>will-change</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>time { will-change: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last of its tag among siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>::before</code></li><li>D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7960">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7961 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7962">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7962" data-page="7962" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7085"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7962 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7085 — ruby × animation-fill-mode</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ruby</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-fill-mode</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-fill-mode</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ruby&gt;</code> — japanese/chinese pinyin-style pronunciation annotation. Which styles apply before start / after end.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ruby&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>中<rt style="font-size:9px">zhōng</rt></ruby>国<rp>(</rp><rt style="font-size:9px">guó</rt><rp>)</rp></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;中&lt;rt&gt;zhōng&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;&lt;ruby&gt;国&lt;rt&gt;guó&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-fill-mode</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ruby { animation-fill-mode: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches if ANY listed selector matches (zero specificity!).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>C. <code>#id</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7961">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7962 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7963">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7963" data-page="7963" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7086"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7963 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7086 — li × offset-distance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-distance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-distance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;. Position along the offset-path (0%–100%).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;li&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Start</li><li value="10">Jumps to 10</li><li>Then 11</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol&gt; &lt;li&gt;Start&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li value=&quot;10&quot;&gt;Jumps to 10&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Then 11&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>offset-distance</b> = <b>percentage</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>li { offset-distance: percentage; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Checkbox/radio is checked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:checked</code></li><li>B. <code>+</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7962">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7963 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7964">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7964" data-page="7964" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7087"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7964 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7087 — video × margin-right</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-right</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-right</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. Distance to the right of the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;video&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:230px;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a5f,#0f172a);border-radius:8px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><span style="width:0;height:0;border-left:22px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-top:14px solid transparent;border-bottom:14px solid transparent"></span></span><span style="position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:8px;font-size:10px;color:#e5e7eb">▶ clip.mp4 — controls</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls width=&quot;320&quot; poster=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.webm&quot; type=&quot;video/webm&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.mp4&quot; type=&quot;video/mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;EN&quot;&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-right</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>video { margin-right: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Value passes / fails validation.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::after</code></li><li>B. <code>::cue</code></li><li>C. <code>:</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7963">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7964 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7965">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7965" data-page="7965" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7088"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7965 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7088 — embed × border-width</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">embed</span> <span class="badge prop">border-width</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-width</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;embed&gt;</code> — embeds an external application (legacy plugin interface). “The element is the target of the URL fragment (#id).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>.class</code></li><li>D. <code>:focus-visible</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7964">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7965 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7966">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7966" data-page="7966" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7089"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7966 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7089 — button × position</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">button</span> <span class="badge prop">position</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">position</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;button&gt;</code> — a clickable button: submit, reset, or script-triggered action. “Direct children only.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::backdrop</code></li><li>B. <code>[attr=value]</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>:last-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7965">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7966 / 8000 · Practice 36</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7967">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7967" data-page="7967" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 7090"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 36</span><span>Page 7967 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 7090 — fieldset × zoom</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">fieldset</span> <span class="badge prop">zoom</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">zoom</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;fieldset&gt;</code> — groups related form controls with a border and a &lt;legend&gt; caption. data-title="A2 · How a page loads (request → pixels)"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VII — Appendix · Appendix</span><span>Page 7982 of 8000</span></div> <ol><li>You type a URL → DNS → the server sends HTML.</li><li>The browser parses HTML top-to-bottom, building the <b>DOM</b>.</li><li><code>&lt;link&gt;</code> CSS is fetched and parsed into the <b>CSSOM</b> (rendering blocks until it arrives — put CSS in <head>, JS with <code>defer</code> at the end).</li><li>DOM + CSSOM → <b>render tree</b> (visible elements + computed styles).</li><li><b>Layout</b>: geometry (box model math, flex/grid solves).</li><li><b>Paint</b>: pixels onto layers → <b>composite</b> on the GPU.</li></ol><p class="mut">Scrolling/zooming and <code>transform</code>/<code>opacity</code> animations skip steps 4–5 (that's why they're cheap).</p> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7981">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7982 / 8000 · Appendix</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7983">Next (specificity visible).</li><li><b>Styles</b> — the cascade in action; strike-throughs = lost rules.</li><li><b>Console</b> — <code>document.querySelector('main')</code>, <code>getComputedStyle(el)</code>.</li><li><b>Network</b> — see what a page actually fetched (fonts, images, 404s).</li><li><b>Responsive mode</b> — resize the viewport; test 360px/768px/1440px.</li><li><b>Layers / Performance</b> — compositing, reflow hotspots.</li><li><b>Accessibility</b> — tree of landmarks, contrast warnings (Chrome).</li><li><b>Storage</b> — cookies, Print it, study it, abuse it — and when you reach page 8000, you deserve a coffee.</p> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7999">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 8000 / 8000 · Appendix</span> <span class="num">Next →</span> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <script> (function(){ var pageEl = document.querySelector('.page[data-page]'); if(!pageEl) return; // hash scroll function goHash(){ if(location.hash){ var t = document.querySelector(location.hash); if(t) t.scrollIntoView(); } } window.addEventListener('load', goHash); window.addEventListener('hashchange', goHash); // keyboard document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) return; if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ var n = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="next"]'); if(n) n.click(); } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; bi < boxes.length; bi++){ (function(box){ box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key !== 'Enter') return; var n = parseInt(box.value, 10); if(!n || n < 1 || n > 8000){ box.value=''; box.placeholder='1–8000'; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
